notes: 1909 three-storey narrow flats, 7.2 m front. Tan-orange painted stucco; ground storey has a double-hung window left of centre, a small door and a barred vent at the far left, and a black iron-gated entry under a dark awning at the right; each of the two upper storeys has an iron balcony across the front with two French-door windows; light cornice. Plain, no ornament invented. Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Ochre brick wall (brick-buff, warm tint), black awning over the gated entry, small dark door left, white-framed ground window, small barred basement vent, front-spanning fire escape balconies with grated decks. Lifted/converted once to #ffffff.
